cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: broad selling, 33% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX +0.17% · BTC +0.62% · Gold -0.48% · Nasdaq100 +0.67%. At the last close, 33% of 111 AI names were green — broad selling. Chip Equipment & AI Hardware did the heavy lifting at +2.36%.

cards.headline: Chip Equipment & AI Hardware leads, Cybersecurity lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is Chip Equipment & AI Hardware at +2.36%; weakest is Cybersecurity at -2.71%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SMR is the standout at -8.52%
cards.body: Leaders: RXRX +8.19%, LRCX +6.98%, AMAT +6.51%, TER +5.19%, FIX +4.92%. Laggards: SMR -8.52%, SYM -6.10%, QCOM -5.82%, CRNC -5.15%.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) -1.36% at $152.71

cards.headline: QCOM moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: QCOM is -5.82% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 50 — Heating Up
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 50/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
